{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # Runs every check `pnpm gen-cli` runs, without writing anything:
      # icon style, imports, ICON_LIST, duplicates, registry, types, lint.
      - name: Verify icons, index and registry
        run: pnpm gen-cli:check",
  "rationale": "The verify job has no timeout, so a stuck run could consume the default 360 minutes. Evidence from P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (literature: 12.9% free / 8.1% paid VM time reduction) and the measured experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (elapsed 41s -> 30s, success preserved 3/3) supports bounding jobs with a custom timeout. Adding timeout-minutes: 30 provides generous headroom for pnpm install and checks while preventing runaway consumption. No build/test coverage is reduced, no permissions are weakened, and no new network access, secrets, or deployment operations are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
